en.bdb: The Gurmukhs only sustain the anbearable cup of love

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh aap gavai na aap ganaiaa|

en.bdb: The Gurmukhs erase their ego and never allow themselves to be noticed.
Effacing duality, they venerate only one Lord.
Accepting Guru as God they by cultivating the words of the Guru, translate them into life.
The Gurmukhs serve and attain the fruits of happiness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh kaar kamai sukh fal paiaa|

en.bdb: This way receiving the cup of love,
They bear the effect of this unbearable in their mind.
